Thanks again for the demo earlier today. As discussed, I

Proposed procurement / signature deadline (internal signature / PO to enable onboarding): 2026-03-26

- Procurement (EdgeFin) — Issue PO / approve payment terms: by 2026-03-26
- Onboarding kickoff (Redwood + EdgeFin) — schedule first enablement call: within 5 business days of SOW signature

Dependencies / blockers we flagged on the call: SOC2 evidence, final payment terms (net30 vs net45), and any necessary procurement forms (W-9, vendor setup).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Review the attached MAP draft and mark any milestone date changes or responsibilities that need to move to EdgeFin or Redwood.
2) Confirm whether the procurement signature deadline of 2026-03-26 aligns with EdgeFin's internal PO/mid-month cycles — if not, please propose an alternative.
3) If those dates look good, we'll update the doc and share a v2 with DocuSign routing for the SOW.

I appreciate a quick reply with procurement's feasibility. Marissa (cc) will be support / SE lead for onboarding and will help scope the enablement plan once we have a signature date. Neha is our GC and will be on standby for any legal questions.

Thanks,

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the recap and the SOC2 report. Quick notes from our side after syncing with procurement: 

- The proposed target of 2026-03-31 looks tight for us given our internal legal + procurement cycles. Our procurement group needs vendor setup and PO approval which typically takes ~3 weeks once legal signs off.
- Proposed procurement signature deadline of 2026-03-26 would require us to have legal redlines back by 2026-03-05 at the latest. Can Redwood commit to turning legal comments into a final SOW by that date?
- Also, our security team had two quick questions: is Redwood willing to provide a SOC2 bridge letter if needed, and can we get an uptime SLA that includes 99.9% availability with credit terms in the SOW?

If we cannot accelerate legal review, procurement suggested a more realistic signature date of 2026-04-14 with full execution by 2026-04-21. That would align to their next vendor intake window. Happy to confirm if Redwood can accept those dates.
